title: Consolidate Main Display ticker ownership and lifecycle-aware projection refresh

gates.name: Host display scheduler and projection regression suite

verify: Before changing production behavior, obtain fresh task-scoped RED from the current Main Display source and a focused host probe: the 50 ms loop has more than one scheduling entry point and its refresh path removes and recreates the four weather-card views on every tick. Do not use W2, W11 or W12 evidence as this task's RED/GREEN.

Implement one Main Display-owned ticker scheduler with one idempotent start/stop owner. The existing Activity pause/resume callbacks may only forward lifecycle to that owner through the existing application/platform seam; pause and detach must stop or prevent rescheduling, and resume/attach must restore exactly one loop. Keep MainActivity wiring-only.

Keep the existing scalar refresh cadence needed for device-time clock/date and accepted colon/countdown presentation, but retain the last rendered Main Display weather projection/presentation inputs and update the card view tree only when those inputs change. This is a local render optimization; Weather Context remains the sole owner of provider refresh, cache/history and weather projection semantics.

Add focused host coverage in the existing DisplayProjectionTest.kt convention. Start from a fresh detached/paused scheduler state, prove duplicate start/attach is coalesced, pause prevents callbacks and resume schedules one loop, and distinguish unchanged-projection scalar ticks from one changed-projection card-tree rebind. Reset the disposable fake scheduler between cases.

Run the clean build, complete host unit suite and static diff gate. Fresh regression output must retain the exact four-card shell, device-time date/time and online/offline/countdown colon behavior; no timer arithmetic, persistence, cancellation, overdue, audio or gesture semantics are reimplemented or changed.

Do not run or require emulator, physical-device, target-ROM, 1280x720 readability, fullscreen, keep-screen-on or audio evidence for this bounded debt task; those remain separate deferred evidence/decision work. Later task verification still owns the normal T3 /verify and /red-verify obligations for the host-verifiable scope.

Stop and route to /spec-design if lifecycle gating or render reuse requires a new module, graph edge, public capability/platform contract, event/message boundary, dependency or owner. Stop and return to /feature-to-tasks FT-001 if the implementation changes accepted product behavior, AC ownership, tier, dependency or cross-feature scope. Do not modify historical task records, scheduler checkpoint, terminal state or RTM lifecycle.

gate_summary.target_evidence: DEFERRED by task scope; no target-device runtime PASS claimed

accepted_residual_risk: W13 is host/static proof only; Samsung/custom-ROM/1280x720 physical evidence remains deferred and no target-device runtime PASS is claimed.

evidence_required: [FT-001-AC-002 / REQ-002] Expected RED: the current Main Display refresh path schedules through two local entry points and rebuilds all four weather-card views at each 50 ms tick. GREEN: one scheduler owner is active at most once, and an unchanged weather projection leaves the existing four-card view tree intact; a changed projection produces exactly one bounded rebind. Compare callback and card-tree counts; artifact is the focused host probe plus bounded source-diff evidence.

[FT-001-AC-003 / REQ-002 / REQ-022] Expected RED: the current ticker has no explicit Activity pause gate, so an attached Main Display can continue its callback loop while the Activity is paused. GREEN: pause/detach produces no further callbacks and resume/attach restores one loop; resumed clock/date output still uses device timezone. Compare callback counts and deterministic date/time output from a fresh fake scheduler; artifact is the host lifecycle probe.

[FT-001-AC-004 / REQ-003] RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the accepted colon/countdown projection is already expected to be GREEN in the current W12 baseline, and observing a meaningful RED would require intentionally breaking accepted Timer & Alert/display behavior rather than observing this scheduling debt; alternative proof: fresh before/after host regression output compares online, offline and countdown colon values while the ticker probe proves no duplicate scheduling.

[Runtime safety] Expected: host probes use only an isolated in-memory/fake scheduler with a known detached/paused initial state, safe reset between cases and no persistence, credentials, target-device access or private neighbor-state writes. Compare cleanup state before and after; artifact is the task-local host result and protocol evidence.
purpose: Remove confirmed local Main Display ticker debt by giving scheduling one owner, honoring existing Activity lifecycle callbacks and avoiding repeated weather-card view-tree reconstruction without changing accepted display or neighbor ownership.
success_outcome: The Main Display has one lifecycle-gated 20 Hz scalar ticker that cannot duplicate or run while paused/detached, and its weather-card view tree is reused until the existing Weather Context projection or presentation inputs change; clock/date/colon behavior and all accepted capability boundaries remain unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not reopen, rewrite, normalize or replace TASK-003-T3-FT-001-W2, TASK-014-T3-FT-001-W11 or TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W12, their identity, lifecycle, evidence or protocol history.
Do not change Yandex provider mapping or Weather Context refresh cadence, cache/history storage, projection contract or provider ownership.

Do not change Timer & Alert state ownership, timer arithmetic, persistence, lifecycle recovery, cancellation, overdue behavior, audio ownership or gesture semantics; timer/colon checks are regression guards only.
Do not optimize Forecast Sessions or its ticker, change forecast behavior, or modify cross-surface gesture semantics.

Do not add a module, dependency, event/message infrastructure, public contract, graph edge, product control or new architecture; do not move orchestration into MainActivity, a generic utility or the composition root.
Do not run or claim target-device, target-ROM, physical 1280x720, fullscreen, readability, keep-screen-on or audio evidence for this task.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if the lifecycle or render-reuse path cannot remain inside the existing Main Display owner and existing Activity/platform seam without a new module, edge, public contract, dependency or Planning Revision change.
Stop and return to /feature-to-tasks FT-001 if execution exposes a different accepted behavior, AC ownership, tier, dependency or material cross-feature scope.

constraints: Main Display remains the primary owner of ticker scheduling, scalar display refresh and local card-view reuse; MainActivity may only forward existing Activity lifecycle callbacks as wiring.

At most one ticker loop may be scheduled for an attached/resumed Main Display; attach, resume, pause and detach handling must be idempotent and must not leave a callback that reschedules itself while paused.

Retain the current scalar refresh cadence needed for the accepted clock/date and colon/countdown presentation; optimize only repeated weather projection/card view-tree work when the render inputs are unchanged.

Weather Context remains the owner of cache/history, refresh cadence, normalization and projection semantics; Main Display may consume only the existing read model and keep a private last-rendered presentation snapshot.
Use the existing Main Display → Weather Context, Main Display → Timer & Alert and Main Display → Android Runtime Adapter boundaries; do not add a new event/message or notification path.
Host proof starts from a known detached/paused fake-scheduler state, is safe to rerun, resets disposable state between cases and leaves no persistent or secret-bearing artifact.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-002 / REQ-002 task-owned implementation delta: a single Main Display ticker owner does not rebuild the four-card view tree on every 50 ms scalar tick; unchanged projection/presentation inputs retain the existing cards, while one changed input causes one bounded rebind and the exact four-card composition remains.

FT-001-AC-003 / REQ-002 / REQ-022 task-owned lifecycle delta: Activity pause and view detach stop or suppress ticker callbacks, Activity resume and view attach restore exactly one loop, and resumed clock/date output remains device-time based.

FT-001-AC-004 / REQ-003 regression target: fresh host output preserves online pulse, offline fixed brightness and active-countdown 382/618 ms colon projection; no Timer & Alert implementation or state ownership is changed.

.memory-bank/contracts/platform-runtime.md#display-runtime-boundary and .memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#dependency-graph: the change remains inside Main Display plus wiring-only MainActivity lifecycle forwarding, with no new module, owner, edge, public contract or dependency.

Focused host quality probe: from isolated detached/paused initial state, scheduler callback counts distinguish duplicate-start prevention, pause suppression, single resume scheduling and unchanged-versus-changed card-tree refresh; cleanup returns the fake scheduler to idle.
